states: Private Pro stack built from this tree, a real agent and seven real containers: a crash that prints a URL with a password and a token, a restart loop, an unhealthy container, an oversized log, a TTY container with colour codes, a clean exit and a healthy container that both print secrets
Switch off (the default): no container carries failureLog in /api/state or /api/resources

Switch on: the drawer of each failed container shows a 'Last log lines' card on the Overview, in view without opening Details, with 'Captured N ago. Secrets masked on the host' and the lines as selectable monospace text in a pre element with no child elements

The crash shows 4 lines with the password and token replaced by [REDACTED]; the oversized log shows its newest 17 lines ending 'FATAL: no space left on device', says 'Cut to the last lines' and scrolls inside a 256 px box; the TTY container shows 'panic: nil map' with no colour codes
The clean exit and the healthy container show no card, and none of their text appears in any API payload
Desktop: the card is 1262 px wide. Phone: 313 px wide, lines wrap, no horizontal page scroll
First build put the card under the closed Details fold, two clicks from the row; it was moved to an Overview content card and rechecked
interactions: Expanded six container rows at 1440 wide and two at 375 wide with a headless browser on pulse-dev (the desktop app's browser pane tools were unavailable in this session) and read the card's text, size, overflow and child elements; viewed the screenshots
Watched the restart-loop container's lines for two minutes: present on every sample, captured once
Restarted the server: the lines returned with the agent's next report
